original_test_intent: Run the explicitly selected AGFHC graphics stress level on the intended AMD GPUs and prove documented success without new kernel, RAS, GPU, thermal or power anomalies.
original_method: Capture GPU topology/health, driver/firmware, AGFHC identity, baseline RAS and timestamped system logs; obtain approval for exactly one recipe level and dedicated no-load window; start independent GPU/utilization/temperature/power/RAS monitoring, execute that recipe once to completion with full output/exit status, then compare new errors/counters and post-health without clearing evidence or escalating levels implicitly.
manual_activity: The owner approves the exact AGFHC level, error policy and dedicated window; an operator monitors GPU/thermal/power/RAS state; the owner reviews complete success and health evidence and decides the verdict.
required_inputs: SUT/GPU topology, driver/firmware and baseline health
Approved AGFHC build/checksum and gfx recipe semantics
Explicit selected gfx_lvl1/2/3/4 scope and expected duration
Dedicated maintenance, thermal/power aborts, storage and console recovery
safety_requirements: Require explicit approval for the selected stress level and no competing GPU workload
Do not silently escalate above gfx_lvl1
Use protected access and preserve complete stdout/stderr/exit status
Start and verify independent monitoring before stress
Preserve logs and compare a timestamped window rather than clearing
Stop on failure, error, RAS delta, GPU loss, thermal/power limit or monitor failure
Do not retry unexplained failures or incomplete evidence
agent_execution_scope: Collect tool/topology identities, criteria and error/health baselines
Validate selected recipe and monitoring streams
After approval run the exact level once on dedicated SUT
Parse documented success and compare test-window health/errors
Perform no level selection/escalation, criteria invention, recovery or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve AGFHC build, selected level/duration and success/error semantics
Authorize/monitor GPU stress and recovery thresholds
Disposition workload/health anomalies and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run exactly one owner-approved AGFHC gfx recipe once with protected full evidence and synchronized independent GPU/thermal/power/RAS and timestamped system-log monitoring.

modernized_recommendation.status: APPROVAL-GATED SINGLE-LEVEL GFX STRESS WITH HEALTH DELTA
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind one selected AGFHC level to a versioned recipe, exact run window and synchronized GPU/RAS/system health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Clarifies level ownership and replaces destructive/empty-log checks with full timestamped deltas while retaining the GFX workload and return-code criteria.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A tee file ending in success can omit monitor failure, new hardware errors or a silently changed stress level.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Higher levels change thermal/power and stability risk; incomplete monitoring or log truncation invalidates the result.

project_override_considerations: If a higher GFX level is requested, create an explicitly approved execution scope and matching duration/thresholds; do not treat the source note as automatic permission. Historical dmesg content must be separated by time rather than erased.
expected_evidence: Approved AGFHC build/checksum/selected level and SUT/GPU/driver/firmware identities
Dedicated/no-load approval and baseline GPU/RAS/kernel/BMC/thermal/power state
Complete AGFHC output/exit/summary/success with run timestamps
Complete independent utilization/temperature/power/RAS stream and post-health
No-clear/no-secret/no-escalation/no-retry audit, recovery record and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source allows multiple stress levels without an authoritative selection/duration, defines an empty dmesg file while asking to clear logs, and lacks monitoring/abort rules. DeepSeek uses invalid PARTIAL/insecure tee-only access and omits level approval plus baseline/post health evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; compatible AGFHC, selected level, criteria, dedicated window, monitoring and recovery are supplyable inputs.

review_improvement: Makes selectable stress intensity an explicit engineering decision and supplies the independent evidence needed to trust a success result.
independent_technical_reasoning: gfx_lvl1 through gfx_lvl4 are not interchangeable because increasing stress changes coverage and blast radius. The source's note cannot authorize escalation, so one exact level must be fixed before execution. A successful process return is necessary but not sufficient: test-window RAS, kernel, GPU and thermal evidence can reveal silent degradation. Clearing logs would erase the very delta used for acceptance and is rejected.
